geography_policy: U.S.-first; global replication only after U.S. measurement package is stable

primary_panel.subsequent_data_policy: 2025+ observations are a separate vintage and cannot be appended to the frozen baseline without a new register version

outcome_policy.multiple_testing: Adjust within each predeclared hypothesis family; do not pool exploratory outcomes into primary evidence.

hypotheses.statement: Indexed resource capacity at t+3 is associated with predeclared necessity, knowledge, and infrastructure proxies at t.
The difference between monetary growth and measured resource-capacity growth is a diagnostic comparator for subsequent inflation, not a causal fiat-money claim.
Real household purchasing power and housing/food/energy burdens may diverge from aggregate GDP growth.
EPI, BLS, and international labor-statistics constructions can produce different wage-productivity gaps; differences are source/vintage findings.
Historical energy-source transitions and energy productivity can be described, but a literal density leap requires a common heat-content basis.
Gold, licensed total-return equities, Treasuries, cash, and housing can be compared for purchasing-power retention without declaring a validated peg.

parameter_policy.uncertainty: HAC or block bootstrap predeclared by lane; no post-hoc interval selection
parameter_policy.imputation: No imputation in primary evidence; missingness is reported and may block a lane

waves.name: research_constitution_and_preregistration
waves.exit_gate: No proxy or model selection after holdout results.

waves.name: us_source_closure_and_vintage_control
waves.exit_gate: Required source identity, release, terms, hash, coverage, and revision fields are complete.

waves.name: measurement_validity_of_R_N_K_I
waves.exit_gate: Direction is stable across at least three declared proxy families or instability is reported.

waves.name: cost_of_living_and_household_welfare
waves.exit_gate: Real welfare and burden outcomes are source-locked and separate from GDP.

waves.name: money_credit_and_inflation
waves.exit_gate: Money definitions, credit measures, baselines, and causal candidates are separated.

waves.name: wage_productivity_and_distribution
waves.exit_gate: EPI, BLS, and international constructions remain separate and decomposed.

waves.name: energy_transition_and_literal_density
waves.exit_gate: Heat-content basis, conversions, uncertainty, and source mix are locked.

waves.name: markets_assets_and_purchasing_power
waves.exit_gate: Licensed total-return and asset provenance gates close or lane is quarantined.

waves.name: global_replication
waves.exit_gate: 30+ economies with common coverage, PPP policy, and leave-one-out checks.

waves.name: causal_identification_external_replication_publication
waves.exit_gate: Two independent causal designs, independent rerun, and human-reviewed package.
